description: List event instances in a date range (default: the current month), optionally on one calendar. Each row's `id` is the INSTANCE id used by attendance, volunteer and get_event tools; `event_id` is the series. Responses are cached by Breeze and may lag up to 15 minutes. Breeze: GET /api/events.

category_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the calendar (from breeze_list_calendars).

eligible.description: Include who is eligible to check in (everyone / tags / forms / none).

name: breeze_list_events
title: List events
